launcher.notes: Engine Launcher v1.3 (WPF): Auto-sync version numbers in all tool card & list labels matching installed/remote versions, plus automatic IN DEV -> READY detection when modes (e.g. Guitar Engine / Shooting Engine) are published in versions.json with custom .enc package filename matching.

beatup.notes: BeatUp Engine v1.4.0.0: Smart Beat-Aware Motif Randomizer + Call & Response (2/4 MADI), Difficulty/Jack/Hand-Bias Rules, Live Re-Roll (R) + Undo, Live Tap-to-Chart Recording (0/5/Ctrl/Space = Space), Persistent Pattern Library & Stamp Brush, Timing Shift/Quantize/Double-Half Scale, Minimap NPS Heatmap, Ghost Note & Stamp Preview, and live Chart Health Validator with Auto-Fix.

ballroom.notes: Ballroom Converter v1.1: Exact Audition Online SLK line count logic (pro Hello genau 1 Zeile weniger in Classic als in Couple), side-by-side Excel & Pochita SLK spreadsheet inspector, in-place Hello repositioning, and custom dance move editor.

silencer.notes: Silencer v2.2 Audio & BPM Prep Tool: WPF Glassmorphism UI & Theme/Blur Studio, proprietary C++17 BPM/Offset & LUFS/MADI engine, automatic FLAC/MP3/M4A->WAV & WAV->OGG conversion with Silence Wav toggle, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16 & +-0.001s offset controls, styled Catppuccin analysis console, and in-app Explorer context menu manager.

auconverter.notes: Au Converter v1.5: Obfuscated & HWID/Whitelist secured BeatUp (4K/8K), OTP 4, Block Beat, and AuPiano (.ssc -> .slk) converter with .SLK Revert & Theme Editor.

onetwo.notes: One Two Party Engine v0.2.2: 1:1 BeatUp Engine compatible SLK export with A26 watermark support, Beat/BeatTime interoperability, and full timing freedom.

aupiano.notes: AuPiano Engine v0.1: Authentic Audition Piano Mode simulation (4K & 8K modes), exact SLK export, full 1000 FPS CleanUI interface, and hardware-accelerated audio/visual sync.

guitar.notes: Guitar Engine v0.1.0.0: Authentic Audition Online Guitar mode with 192-tick snap precision, 5-fret & 6-fret mechanics, pitch bends, flameout gauge, BeatUp Engine styled glass UI, and built-in chart & song browser.
